title: UpdatesStatus

protocolVersion.description: A wire protocol version: one integer, bumped only on a breaking change.

bundledClaudeCodeVersion.description: The version of Claude Code the running version bundles; null when it could not be read.

launcherVersion.description: The version of the launcher running the environment.

oneOf.description: The launcher of a native service manages updates: the environment stages them and the launcher switches.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

lastPoll.description: When the host-side updater last polled updates.status; null before its first poll.

oneOf.description: A host-side updater outside the container carries out the environment's plan: it pulls, recreates and rolls back.

reason.description: Why nothing manages updates, for people: serve runs in the foreground, with no launcher.

oneOf.description: Nothing can update the environment: no launcher runs it and it is no container.

manager.description: Who manages the environment's updates: launcher with its version, outside with the host-side updater's last poll, or none with why.

origin.description: A forge origin: https, or http for a LAN or tailnet instance, then the host in lower case and a port only when it is not the scheme's default (https://git.example.com:5526); no userinfo, path or trailing slash.

kind.description: The kind of forge the origin is, which the releases are read with.

repository.description: The repository the releases are published on, owner/name.

releaseSource.description: Where the environment reads its releases: the forge's origin and kind, and the repository, owner/name; compiled into each build.

anyOf.description: A release's version: a semantic version without the tag's v (0.4.2, 1.0.0-beta.2); one with a prerelease part is a prerelease, which only the beta channel follows.

newest.description: The channel's newest release as the last check that read it found it; null before one did, or when it found none.

at.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

oneOf.description: The check read the channel, and staged its target if it had one.

at.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

reason.description: Why a check failed: no_release_access (no forge account for the release origin, or its token was refused), unreachable (the forge did not answer, or failed), manifest (the release's manifest is missing or not its schema), artefact (this platform's artefact did not download, or does not match its size and SHA-256) or install (the launcher refused to install it). A failed check is tried again at the next.

oneOf.description: The check failed: why, and what failed.

anyOf.description: The last check of the channel: when it ran, and whether it read the channel and staged its target or failed, with why.

lastCheck.description: The last check of the channel since the environment started; null before the first.

lastReadAt.description: When the last check that read the channel began, kept in the data directory across restarts; null before any did, absent from an environment that predates it. Until the first check since the environment started ends, lastCheck is null while this says when the channel was last read: before the start while readSinceStart is false, else by that check, which found what newest, target and passedOver show and is staging it (#1812, #1818).

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

readSinceStart.description: Whether a check since the environment started read the channel, whatever it found and however later checks ended: with newest null, it found no newest; else lastReadAt is from before the start. Absent from an environment that predates it (#1818).

version.description: A release's version: a semantic version without the tag's v (0.4.2, 1.0.0-beta.2); one with a prerelease part is a prerelease, which only the beta channel follows.

source.description: Why it is the target: pin (the pinned version) or channel (the channel's newest, auto-update being on).

anyOf.description: The release the environment would update to: its version, and whether the pin or the channel names it.

target.description: The release the environment would update to, as the last check that read the channel found it (a failed check leaves it); null for none: before a check read the channel, with auto-update off and nothing pinned, with nothing newer than what runs, with the pinned version running, or with the release passed over.

version.description: A release's version: a semantic version without the tag's v (0.4.2, 1.0.0-beta.2); one with a prerelease part is a prerelease, which only the beta channel follows.

source.description: Why it is the target: pin (the pinned version) or channel (the channel's newest, auto-update being on).

reason.description: Why a release that would be the target is not: schema (its database schema is below the database's, and nothing of it is downloaded), artefact (it has no artefact for this platform) or missing (the pinned version has no release that is not a draft).

anyOf.description: A release that would be the target and is not: its version, whether the pin or the channel names it, and why.

passedOver.description: The release the last check that read the channel found would be the target and is not, with why; null for none.

oneOf.description: Nothing to do: the environment runs its target, or has none.

updateId.description: An update's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it takes a target, named by each of the update's notices, the launcher's switch, its database snapshot and its outcome record; a newer release replacing the target gets a new one.

source.description: Where a pending update comes from: channel (the channel's newest release, auto-update being on), pin (the pinned version), request (updates.apply or POST /api/update by version) or desktop (the artefact a desktop handed its local environment).

oneOf.description: The target is being downloaded, checked and installed; staging ignores idle.

updateId.description: An update's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it takes a target, named by each of the update's notices, the launcher's switch, its database snapshot and its outcome record; a newer release replacing the target gets a new one.

toVersion.description: The version the update goes to.

source.description: Where a pending update comes from: channel (the channel's newest release, auto-update being on), pin (the pinned version), request (updates.apply or POST /api/update by version) or desktop (the artefact a desktop handed its local environment).

since.description: When an update first became pending, kept across a replaced target and restarts.

deferUntil.description: since plus the deferral cap: past it, busy work no longer holds the update.

reference.description: The image's reference, tagged with the exact version: git.systemtech.dev:5526/david/agent-harness:0.5.0.

digest.description: The image's digest, sha256: then 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits: a pull is checked against it.

anyOf.description: The release's container image: its exact version reference and its digest.

image.description: Managed outside, the target's image the host-side updater pulls and checks; null for a native environment.

reason.description: Why the environment is busy: run-starting and run-running (a run is starting or running), terminal-running (a terminal's shell runs a command in its foreground, a build or a watcher, rather than waiting at its prompt), parked-prompt (a run parked on a prompt within the idle window, preset ten minutes), recent-activity (a run started or ended, or the environment started, within the idle window).

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

until.description: When the reason stops counting if nothing else happens; null while a run is starting or running.

anyOf.description: What a waiting update waits on: the reason the environment is busy, and until when.

waitsOn.description: What it waits on; null when nothing holds it and it drains at the next tick.

oneOf.description: Installed, the update waits for idle, the deferral cap or a request: on what.

reason.description: Why an update cannot go on by itself: launcher (the target needs a newer launcher than the running one and no stepping stone leads there; run service install from the target's release).

toVersion.description: The target that cannot be reached: service install from its release unblocks it.

message.description: Why, and what unblocks it, for people: service install from the target's release.

oneOf.description: The update cannot go on by itself: why, its target, and what unblocks it.

pending.description: The pending update with its state: current, staging, waiting on what, ready, draining, switching, or blocked with why.

anyOf.description: An update's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it takes a target, named by each of the update's notices, the launcher's switch, its database snapshot and its outcome record; a newer release replacing the target gets a new one.

fromVersion.description: The version the update went from.

toVersion.description: The version the update went to.

toVersion.description: The version the update went to.

stage.description: Where an update failed: switch (the launcher refused the switch, or a container's stop never came, and the same version runs on), trial (the new version did not pass its startup gate) or crash-loop (it exited three times within ten minutes of its commit).

reason.description: A short code naming the failure: the launcher's refusal of the switch, no-stop when a container's stop never came after its drain (#348), the outcome record's reason (deadline for a trial that missed its gate, credential for one whose OS keychain read the person refused or left unanswered, #1689), or unknown when no record was left.

rolledBack.description: Whether the database snapshot was restored: true after a trial or a crash loop, false after a refused switch, which changed nothing.

oneOf.description: The update failed: at which stage, why, and whether it was rolled back.

anyOf.description: How the last update ended: updated, or failed with its stage, reason and rollback.

lastOutcome.description: How the last update ended; null before any.

failedVersions.description: Versions whose update failed: never taken again automatically, though updates.apply may retry one.

installed.description: The versions installed, as the launcher lists them; empty with no launcher.

description: The environment's updates: what runs, who manages its updates, where its releases are read, the channel's newest, the last check and the target it found, the pending update with its state, the last outcome, the versions that failed and those installed.
